title: impl_report
description: What an engineer hands to the testers after implementing a bead.

type.description: Omit this. The orchestrator stamps it when it stores the message.

summary.description: What you did and why, in a few sentences.

files_changed.description: Paths you changed, relative to the repository root.

how_to_verify.description: The commands or steps a tester runs to see the change working.

risks.description: Anything you are unsure about, one per entry.

questions.description: Open points for the testers or the product owner, one per entry.

commit.description: The git sha of the commit this report describes.
